standard-dialogue-dialogue-with-iron-man.npc: Hail, Iron[man/woman]! What can I do for you?

steps.npc: When you play as an Iron[man/woman], you do everything for yourself. You don't trade with other players, or take their items, or accept their help.
As an Iron[man/woman], you choose to have these restrictions imposed on you, so everyone knows you're doing it properly.
If you think you have what it takes, you can choose to become a Hardcore Iron[man/woman].

In addition to the standard restrictions, Hardcore Iron[man/woman] only have one life. In the event of a dangerous death, your Hardcore Iron[man/woman] status will be downgraded to that of a standard Iron[man/woman], and your
stats will be frozen on the Hardcore Iron[man/woman] hiscores.
For the ultimate challenge, you can choose to become an Ultimate Iron[man/woman], a game mode inspired by the player IronNoBank.
In addition to the standard restrictions, Ultimate Iron[man/woman] are blocked from using the bank, and they drop all their items when they die.
You're a standard Iron[man/woman]. You can downgrade yourself to a normal player if you like.

standard-dialogue-dialogue-without-iron-.npc: Hello, [player name]. I'm the Iron[man/woman] tutor. What can I do for you?

steps.npc: When you play as an Iron[man/woman], you do everything for yourself. You don't trade with other players, or take their items, or accept their help.
As an Iron[man/woman], you choose to have these restrictions imposed on you, so everyone knows you're doing it properly.
If you think you have what it takes, you can choose to become a Hardcore Iron[man/woman].

In addition to the standard restrictions, Hardcore Iron[men/women] only have one life. In the event of a dangerous death, your Hardcore Iron[men/women] status will be downgraded to that of a standard Iron[man/woman], and your
stats will be frozen on the Hardcore Iron[man/woman] hiscores.
If you have some friends, you could stand alone... Together, as Group Ironmen. Group Ironmen have the same restrictions as regular Iron[men/women] except you can trade your items with each other!
If you are a daring bunch, you could even try Hardcore Group Ironmen. With Hardcore Group Ironmen you have a set number of lives, when they reach zero, you will become regular Group Ironmen.
If you ever decided to invite experienced players to your group, you would become Unranked Group Ironmen, which are no longer shown on the Group Ironman hiscores.
For the ultimate challenge, you can choose to become an Ultimate Iron[man/woman], a game mode inspired by the player IronNoBank.
In addition to the standard restrictions, Ultimate Iron[men/women] are blocked from using the bank, and they drop all their items when they die.
You can choose to become an Iron[man/woman] while you're on Tutorial Island. Although you can't do that on this account, you might like to bear it in mind for the future.
